title: indigo_ccd_driver: accept a CCD_LOCAL_MODE.DIR folder that does not exist yet when its parent is writable, the first saved frame creates it
description:
Owner report 2026-11-17: with the Scheduler Agent's per-task folder (FOLDER item of AGENT_SCHEDULER_DATA or @folder), a task whose folder does not exist yet fails with 'CCD Imager Simulator @ vega: Folder "/home/rumen/indigo_image_cache/Rosette Nebula/" is not writtable'.

Cause (source inspection): the CCD_LOCAL_MODE handler in indigo_libs/indigo_ccd_driver.c (~line 835) checks indigo_uni_is_writable() on DIR and sets CCD_LOCAL_MODE to ALERT when the folder does not exist. Saving a frame already creates the folder with indigo_uni_mkdir() (lines ~2265, 2412, 2498, guarded by indigo_is_sandboxed), so only the early check rejects it.

Proposed fix: in the CCD_LOCAL_MODE handler, create the folder with indigo_uni_mkdir() (same indigo_is_sandboxed guard as the save path) before the writability check; keep the alert when the folder cannot be created or is not writable. Creating the folder in the Scheduler Agent instead is not suitable: the scheduler may run on a different host than the CCD driver.

Also: reproduce first (scheduler task with a folder that does not exist on ccd_simulator), find exactly which component turns the CCD_LOCAL_MODE alert into the task failure, and confirm the task runs after the fix. Tests: CCD driver test for setting DIR to a non-existent nested folder (created, state OK) and to an uncreatable path (ALERT); scheduler integration test with a per-task folder that does not exist yet. Document the behaviour in indigo_docs/PROPERTIES.md (CCD_LOCAL_MODE row) if it describes the check.

outcome.summary: Code is correct and matches the owner decision; tests effective and pass (test_uni_io all; test_ccd_simulator new case; sequencer 'simulator imaging*' 2/2; test_agent_scheduler full suite 106/106 twice). Requested changes: (1) indigo_test/test_runner.h:156-160 comment is now false: it says the framework rejects a missing $HOME/indigo_image_cache and that an empty private home makes every CCD driver publish CCD_LOCAL_MODE in ALERT; with indigo_uni_is_creatable() a missing folder under a writable home is accepted. Reword it (the mkdir may stay, e.g. so saved frames have their folder / to keep the fixture like a real home) or drop the mkdir with the comment. (2) bugfixes rule and ticket description: no ticket note records the reproduction before the fix, the component that turns the CCD_LOCAL_MODE alert into the task failure, and the result after the fix; add it with flow note before close. Notes, no change required: indigo_ccd_driver.c:836 sandbox branch is consistent with the save paths (2266/2413/2499 skip mkdir when sandboxed); PROPERTIES.md CCD_LOCAL_MODE row does not describe the check, no update needed; no driver version bump applies (framework change). edit_of_running_task_is_deferred runs in its own forked child, never sets imager_checks_folder and does not touch CCD_LOCAL_MODE; its failure is pre-existing timing sensitivity (2 s task can end between the RUNNING observation and the edit under parallel load), not caused by this change. Minor/out of scope: test_agent_scheduler.c new case ASSERT_FALSE(created) only checks the stand-in, which never creates folders; Windows UNC path to a missing share walks up to '\\' (current drive root) and may be accepted, the save then reports the error; unit test returns without removing its temp dir if an early ASSERT fails.

Round 2: both round-1 requests done (test_runner.h:156-158 comment reworded; owner-visible reproduction note naming Sequencer.js on_update, results and limitations). Re-verified independently: indigo_uni_is_creatable (indigo_uni_io.c:2673-2727) walks to nearest existing ancestor, accepts only a writable directory, creates nothing; CCD_LOCAL_MODE handler (indigo_ccd_driver.c:835-836) uses it except when sandboxed, matching the save path guards at 2266/2413/2499; existing-folder behaviour unchanged. Tests cover non-existent nested folder OK + not created, creation on first save, ALERT below regular file and read-only folder, sequencer real Sequencer.js+ccd_simulator, scheduler stand-in. PROPERTIES.md does not describe the check, no change needed. Reviewer runs on rebuilt worktree lib: test_uni_io pass, test_ccd_simulator all pass, test_agent_scripting_sequencer 68/68, test_agent_scheduler 106/106. Non-blocking: in test_agent_scheduler task_folder_that_does_not_exist_yet_runs a failing REQUIRE leaves imager_checks_folder true and the temp dir behind (failure path only); Windows branch unbuilt (documented).

history.text: Owner decision 2026-11-17 (replaces the proposed fix): do NOT create the folder when CCD_LOCAL_MODE.DIR is set and never remove folders. In the CCD_LOCAL_MODE handler: if DIR exists, keep the indigo_uni_is_writable() check; if it does not exist, walk up to the nearest existing ancestor and accept DIR (state OK) when that ancestor is a writable directory, otherwise ALERT with the existing message. The folder is created at the first save by the existing indigo_uni_mkdir() calls. Keep the indigo_is_sandboxed behaviour consistent with the save path. If a portable helper is needed (e.g. an exists/is-directory check), use or add it in indigo_uni_io (indigo_libs), not platform code in the CCD driver. Tests: DIR set to a non-existent nested folder under a writable dir -> OK and no folder created; first saved frame creates it; DIR under a non-writable or non-directory ancestor -> ALERT; scheduler integration test with a per-task folder that does not exist yet runs the task. Update indigo_docs/PROPERTIES.md CCD_LOCAL_MODE description if it describes the check.
Building libs and running unit and ccd simulator tests
Running full ccd_simulator, sequencer and scheduler integration tests
Running uni_io unit, ccd_simulator, sequencer and scheduler tests in worktree
Implementation resumed: the review requested changes
Review round 1 changes sent back to implementer: stale test_runner.h comment, reproduction note

Reproduction before the fix (old CCD code): test_agent_scripting_sequencer "simulator imaging in a folder that does not exist" (real Sequencer.js, Imager Agent, ccd_simulator) failed with 'Folder ".../Rosette Nebula/" is not writtable', 'CCD_LOCAL_MODE reports alert', 'Sequence failed'. test_ccd_simulator simulator_local_mode_accepts_a_folder_that_can_be_created failed with 'Simulator timeout: CCD_LOCAL_MODE state 1'. Component that turned the alert into the task failure: Sequencer.js on_update, which waits for CCD_LOCAL_MODE on the Imager Agent after set_directory/set_object_name/set_file_template steps and fails the sequence with 'CCD_LOCAL_MODE reports alert'. The Scheduler Agent sets DIR fire-and-forget and ignores the state; the Imager Agent only mirrors it. After the fix: flow check passed; test_ccd_simulator 30/30, test_agent_scripting_sequencer 68/68, test_agent_scheduler 106/106 (one earlier full run had a flaky edit_of_running_task_is_deferred that passed alone 3/3 and in the next full run), test_uni_io passed. Limitation: the scheduler integration test uses a stand-in imager whose CCD_LOCAL_MODE check calls the production indigo_uni_is_creatable (flag-enabled only for that test); it fails the task with the old strict indigo_uni_is_writable check. Real Scheduler + Imager Agent + CCD together are not run in one test. The Windows branch of indigo_uni_is_creatable (GetFileAttributesA) was not built or run.
Round 2 review: reading diff and notes
Building worktree lib and running uni_io, ccd_simulator, sequencer, scheduler tests
